errors.text_span: rises to several thousand by around −0.6 to −0.5
errors.evidence: The description oversimplifies the trend in this section. The line rises to a local peak at x≈-0.6 (Count≈4500) and then dips at x≈-0.5 (Count≈3500). Stating that it simply "rises" in this interval is inaccurate.
The spike mentioned is located at a polarity score of approximately 0.45, which is exactly halfway between the 0.4 and 0.5 positions on the axis. Describing this location as "near 0.5" is imprecise.
